title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have arrived at PXL, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Which ride should we go on first?!
Oh, but there's new Phenny merch, right? I wanna go check it out, but... Maybe we should do souvenirs at the end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We also have to catch the special seasonal parade, Saki! Not to mention there's all the new finger food we have to try too! They all looked so good when I saw them on TV!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Looks like you two are a lot more excited than the actual birthday girl.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! T-That's not true... Right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, right. I definitely wasn't expecting you to bring me to PXL to celebrate my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We have Dad to thank for giving us those discount tickets♪
There was no way we could pass up this chance to give you a PXL birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I couldn't help but laugh when I got your message, Saki. You were clearly very excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! For real?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It sounded like you couldn't wait to celebrate Ichika's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Since we've got PXL expert Kohane, and Emu and Nene with us today, let's check out as many of their recommendations as we can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know if I qualify as an expert...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I came up with a route that I think everyone will enjoy. So I hope we can all have fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First up, let's go get your birthday sticker.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, do you get some special bonuses for your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! The staff also makes sure to wish you a happy birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You can get them over there. I'll show you.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Amazing. I think that was the tenth staff member who's wished me a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's quite a different birthday experience, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing, though. I feel like I'm in the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh yeah, there was that little kid before who wished you a happy birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They saw the staff wishing you a happy birthday and waved to you. It was so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Seeing Ichika waving back while blushing was also adorable.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Well, what was I supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She's blushing again.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Minori & Honami
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this where you'll most likely get to meet Phenny?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I think he'll be coming out of that staff door soon...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right... I've been here many times before, and I didn't know about this at all. This isn't written on the website or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I usually either come across this info online or search it up myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's amazing. I think you know more than we do...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhmm! It makes me happy hearing how much you know about Phoenix Wonderland☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe, that's how much I love PXL.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Alright then, let's wait somewhere a little further away. We'll be in the way if we're too close to the door.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, you're so considerate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It won't be long until Phenny comes out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I gotta make sure to ask for a photo...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't forget to shake his hand too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think I can pass on that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? But won't you want to when he's right in front of you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You should let him give you the ultimate fan service, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-Is it just me, or are those two a little more serious about this...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Welcome to Phenny's Nightmare! For this attraction, please proceed forward in pairs.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Who's next? Oh, a star of the day! Happy birthday!
Be careful not to get lost in the world of nightmares.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. Alright, let's go, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. They called it the world of nightmares, but it wasn't scary at all when I went last time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is a haunted house of sorts for kids, after all. It's more popular for its cute props.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane! Look! There's a kappa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Wow! That's a character that only appears during summer! I've been so excited to see it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like some people are having a fun time. It's rare to be in a haunted house without any screaming.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't think I've seen anyone scared in... Actually, scratch that. I think I have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you possibly referring to...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: AHHH!!! Hurry, Hona! Something's over there and it's staring right at us!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: AHHH!!! That's a kappa! Wait for me, Saki!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...those two?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yup. I guess it doesn't take much to scare them...
